units.locator: Article 51. Conclusion of a contract following an electronic procedure
units.text: б) the contract price corresponding to the price offered under this Federal Law by the participant with whom the contract is to be concluded, taking account of regulatory legal acts adopted under Article 14 of this Federal Law and the provisions of Articles 28 and 29 of this Federal Law, and the price of each individual stage of performance determined under Article 34(2) of this Federal Law, if the draft contract provides for such stages. This information shall be included in the draft contract except where it contains the information provided for in subpoints “в” or “г” of this point;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 1 Part 2 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Conclusion of a contract following an electronic procedure
units.text: в) the maximum contract price and the unit price of goods, works or services corresponding to the maximum contract price specified in the procurement notice, taking account of regulatory legal acts adopted under Article 14 of this Federal Law and the provisions of Articles 28 and 29 of this Federal Law, in the case provided for in Article 22(24) of this Federal Law. The unit price shall be determined by reducing the initial unit price specified in the notice in proportion to the reduction in the initial total of unit prices offered by the participant with whom the contract is to be concluded;
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 1 Part 2 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Conclusion of a contract following an electronic procedure
units.text: г) the fee payable under this Federal Law by the participant with whom the contract is to be concluded for conclusion of the contract to the account in which transactions involving funds received by the contracting authority are recorded under the legislation of the Russian Federation, in the cases provided for by this Federal Law;
units.label: Subpoint «г» Point 1 Part 2 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Conclusion of a contract following an electronic procedure
units.text: д) the information specified in Article 43(1) of this Federal Law, point 1, subpoints “а”, “б”, “г”, “е” and “п”, and point 2, subpoints “а” and “б”, and, for an electronic tender, the information specified in point 2(г) of that paragraph. The information specified in Article 43(1)(1), subpoints “а”, “б”, “г” and “е”, of this Federal Law shall be stated using the unified information system as at the date and time the draft contract is prepared;
units.label: Subpoint «д» Point 1 Part 2 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Conclusion of a contract following an electronic procedure
units.text: е) other documents, where available;
units.label: Subpoint «е» Point 1 Part 2 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Conclusion of a contract following an electronic procedure
units.text: 2) when preparing and posting the draft contract under point 1 of this paragraph, the contracting authority may, except in the case provided for in Article 22(24) of this Federal Law, increase the quantity of goods supplied by a value not exceeding the difference between the contract price specified in point 1(б) of this paragraph and the initial (maximum) contract price. The unit price must not exceed the price obtained by dividing the contract price specified in point 1(б) of this paragraph by the quantity of goods specified in the procurement notice. The participant may refuse to conclude a contract on these terms by preparing a record of disagreements in the case specified in paragraph 3(2)(б) of this Article.
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Conclusion of a contract following an electronic procedure
units.text: 3. No later than five working days following the contracting authority’s posting of the draft contract under paragraph 2 of this Article, the participant with whom the contract is to be concluded shall take one of the following actions:
units.label: Part 3 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Conclusion of a contract following an electronic procedure
units.text: 1) sign the draft contract with the enhanced electronic signature of a person authorized to act on its behalf and simultaneously post the signed draft on the electronic platform and in the unified information system (using the platform, without publication on the official website), together with a document confirming provision of contract performance security under this Federal Law, except in the cases provided for by this Federal Law. The participant shall also:
units.label: Point 1 Part 3 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Conclusion of a contract following an electronic procedure
units.text: а) in the cases provided for in Article 37 of this Federal Law, simultaneously submit to the contracting authority the information and documents specified in that Article;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 1 Part 3 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Conclusion of a contract following an electronic procedure
units.text: б) deposit the fee it offered for conclusion of the contract in the account in which transactions involving funds received by the contracting authority are recorded under the legislation of the Russian Federation, if the supplier (contractor, service provider) selection under this Federal Law determined a fee payable by the participant for conclusion of the contract;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 1 Part 3 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Conclusion of a contract following an electronic procedure
units.text: 2) prepare a record of disagreements, sign it with the enhanced electronic signature of a person authorized to act on its behalf, and post it on the electronic platform and in the unified information system (using the platform, without publication on the official website) in one or more of the following cases:
units.label: Point 2 Part 3 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Conclusion of a contract following an electronic procedure
units.text: а) disagreement concerning information included in the draft contract under paragraph 2(1) of this Article, specifying the information that does not comply with the procurement notice requirements or with the provisions of that participant’s application;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 2 Part 3 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Conclusion of a contract following an electronic procedure
units.text: б) refusal to conclude a contract containing the terms provided for in paragraph 2(2) of this Article;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 2 Part 3 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Conclusion of a contract following an electronic procedure
units.text: 3) in the case provided for in Article 95(17.2)(1) of this Federal Law, prepare a refusal to conclude the contract, sign it with the enhanced electronic signature of a person authorized to act on its behalf, and post it on the electronic platform.
units.label: Point 3 Part 3 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Conclusion of a contract following an electronic procedure
units.text: 4. No later than two working days following the posting of information and documents under paragraph 3 of this Article by the participant with whom the contract is to be concluded, the contracting authority shall take one of the following actions:
units.label: Part 4 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Conclusion of a contract following an electronic procedure
units.text: 1) if the participant has posted information and documents under paragraph 3(1) of this Article, sign the contract with the enhanced electronic signature of a person authorized to act on behalf of the contracting authority and post it in the unified information system and on the electronic platform (using the unified information system), except in the cases established by this Federal Law and no earlier than the time specified in paragraph 1 of this Article. If the supplier (contractor, service provider) selection under this Federal Law determined a fee payable by the participant for conclusion of the contract, the contracting authority shall perform these actions only once the fee offered by that participant has reached the account in which transactions involving funds received by the contracting authority are recorded under the legislation of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 1 Part 4 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Conclusion of a contract following an electronic procedure
units.text: 2) use the unified information system to prepare and post, without its signature, a draft contract taking account of the information in the record of disagreements posted by the participant with whom the contract is to be concluded under paragraph 3(2) of this Article, in the unified information system (without publication on the official website) and on the electronic platform (using the unified information system);
units.label: Point 2 Part 4 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Conclusion of a contract following an electronic procedure
units.text: 3) use the unified information system to prepare and post, without its signature, a draft contract that disregards or only partly takes account of the information in the record of disagreements posted by the participant under paragraph 3(2) of this Article, in the unified information system (without publication on the official website) and on the electronic platform (using the unified information system). When doing so, the contracting authority shall also use the unified information system to prepare information explaining its refusal to take account of all or part of the information in the record of disagreements, sign it with the enhanced electronic signature of a person authorized to act on its behalf, and post it in the unified information system without publication on the official website. The information specified in paragraph 3(2)(б) of this Article must, however, be taken into account.
units.label: Point 3 Part 4 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Conclusion of a contract following an electronic procedure
units.text: 5. No later than one working day following the contracting authority’s posting of information and documents under paragraph 4(2) or (3) of this Article, the participant with whom the contract is to be concluded shall perform the actions specified in paragraph 3(1) of this Article. No later than two working days following those actions, the contracting authority shall post the contract, signed with the enhanced electronic signature of a person authorized to act on its behalf, in the unified information system and on the electronic platform using that system, except in the cases established by this Federal Law and no earlier than the time specified in paragraph 1 of this Article. The contract is deemed concluded on the day the contract signed with that authorized person’s enhanced electronic signature is posted in the unified information system. In the cases provided for in Article 103(5) of this Federal Law, the signed contract shall not be published on the official website.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Conclusion of a contract following an electronic procedure
units.text: 6. If the participant with whom the contract is to be concluded fails to comply with paragraph 3 (except in the case specified in paragraph 3(3) of this Article and also where the participant has not complied with paragraph 3(3) of this Article within the period established by paragraph 3 of this Article) and paragraph 5 of this Article:
units.label: Part 6 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Conclusion of a contract following an electronic procedure
units.text: 1) the participant is deemed to have evaded conclusion of the contract;
units.label: Point 1 Part 6 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Conclusion of a contract following an electronic procedure
units.text: 2) no later than one working day following expiry of the period for the participant to comply with paragraphs 3 and 5 of this Article, the contracting authority shall:
units.label: Point 2 Part 6 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Conclusion of a contract following an electronic procedure
units.text: а) use the unified information system to prepare a record of the participant’s evasion of conclusion of the contract, sign it with the enhanced electronic signature of a person authorized to act on its behalf, and post it in the unified information system and on the electronic platform using that system. The record shall contain its signing date, the identification number of the application of the participant that evaded conclusion of the contract, and the requirements the participant failed to meet;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 2 Part 6 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Conclusion of a contract following an electronic procedure
units.text: б) on the day the record specified in subpoint “а” of this point is posted in the unified information system, prepare and send a request to enter information on the participant in the register of bad-faith suppliers (contractors, service providers), in the procedure provided for in Article 104(10) of this Federal Law;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 2 Part 6 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Conclusion of a contract following an electronic procedure
units.text: 3) no later than one hour after the record of evasion is posted under point 2(а) of this paragraph, the electronic platform operator shall notify the participant of that posting.
units.label: Point 3 Part 6 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Conclusion of a contract following an electronic procedure
units.text: 7. In the procedure established by this Article, the contracting authority shall conclude the contract with the participant whose application has been assigned the next rank under this Federal Law and who has not withdrawn it under this Federal Law, if:
units.label: Part 7 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Conclusion of a contract following an electronic procedure
units.text: 1) a participant has been deemed to have evaded conclusion of the contract under paragraph 6 of this Article;
units.label: Point 1 Part 7 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Conclusion of a contract following an electronic procedure
units.text: 2) the contracting authority refuses to conclude the contract under Article 31(9) and (10) of this Federal Law.
units.label: Point 2 Part 7 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Conclusion of a contract following an electronic procedure
units.text: 8. The contracting authority may bring a court action for compensation for losses caused by a participant’s evasion of conclusion of the contract to the extent not covered by the application security.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 52. Declaring an open competitive method unsuccessful. Consequences of such a declaration
units.text: Article 52. Declaring an open competitive method unsuccessful. Consequences of such a declaration
units.label: Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. Declaring an open competitive method unsuccessful. Consequences of such a declaration
units.text: 1. An open competitive procurement method shall be declared unsuccessful in the following cases:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. Declaring an open competitive method unsuccessful. Consequences of such a declaration
units.text: 1) only one procurement application has been submitted by the application deadline;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. Declaring an open competitive method unsuccessful. Consequences of such a declaration
units.text: 2) after examination, only one application meets the requirements established in the procurement notice;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. Declaring an open competitive method unsuccessful. Consequences of such a declaration
units.text: 3) no procurement applications have been submitted by the application deadline;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. Declaring an open competitive method unsuccessful. Consequences of such a declaration
units.text: 4) after examination, the procurement commission has rejected all applications;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. Declaring an open competitive method unsuccessful. Consequences of such a declaration
units.text: 5) all participants that have not withdrawn their applications under this Federal Law have been deemed under this Federal Law to have evaded conclusion of the contract;
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. Declaring an open competitive method unsuccessful. Consequences of such a declaration
units.text: 6) under Article 31(9) and (10) of this Federal Law, the contracting authority has refused to conclude a contract with the participant that submitted the sole application, or with the participant whose application was found under this Federal Law to be the only one meeting the requirements in the procurement notice.
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. Declaring an open competitive method unsuccessful. Consequences of such a declaration
units.text: 2. In the case provided for in paragraph 1(1) of this Article, an electronic tender or electronic auction shall be conducted in the procedure established by this Federal Law, subject to the following specific rules:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. Declaring an open competitive method unsuccessful. Consequences of such a declaration
units.text: 1) no later than one hour after the application deadline, the electronic platform operator shall, under Article 43(6)(9) of this Federal Law, send the contracting authority the application (all its parts) and the information and documents specified in Article 43(6)(2) and (3) of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. Declaring an open competitive method unsuccessful. Consequences of such a declaration
units.text: 2) no later than two working days from the day following the application deadline, but no later than the date for determining supplier (contractor, service provider) selection results, as set in the procurement notice:
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. Declaring an open competitive method unsuccessful. Consequences of such a declaration
units.text: а) the procurement commission members shall examine the information and documents sent by the electronic platform operator under point 1 of this paragraph and decide whether the application meets the procurement notice requirements or must be rejected on grounds specified in Article 48(5) and (12), for an electronic tender, or Article 48(12)(1)–(8), for an electronic auction, of this Federal Law. They shall also sign with enhanced electronic signatures the record of supplier (contractor, service provider) selection results prepared by the contracting authority using the electronic platform;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 2 Part 2 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. Declaring an open competitive method unsuccessful. Consequences of such a declaration
units.text: б) the contracting authority shall use the electronic platform to prepare the record of supplier (contractor, service provider) selection results and, after the procurement commission members sign it under subpoint “а” of this point, sign it with the enhanced electronic signature of a person authorized to act on its behalf and send it to the electronic platform operator. No later than one hour after receiving it, the operator shall perform the actions specified in Article 48(16) of this Federal Law;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 2 Part 2 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. Declaring an open competitive method unsuccessful. Consequences of such a declaration
units.text: 3) in an electronic tender, no evaluation against the application evaluation criteria set in the procurement notice shall be carried out;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. Declaring an open competitive method unsuccessful. Consequences of such a declaration
units.text: 4) the record of supplier (contractor, service provider) selection results must contain the information specified in Article 48(17)(1), (2) and (4)–(7) of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. Declaring an open competitive method unsuccessful. Consequences of such a declaration
units.text: 5) after the record of supplier (contractor, service provider) selection results is posted in the unified information system, the participant may send the request provided for in Article 48(18) of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 5 Part 2 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. Declaring an open competitive method unsuccessful. Consequences of such a declaration
units.text: 6) if a decision under point 2(а) of this paragraph finds the application compliant with the procurement notice requirements, the contract with the participant that submitted it shall be concluded under Article 93(1)(25) of this Federal Law in the procedure established by this Federal Law.
units.label: Point 6 Part 2 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. Declaring an open competitive method unsuccessful. Consequences of such a declaration
units.text: 3. If, in the case provided for in paragraph 1(2) of this Article, an electronic tender is declared unsuccessful following examination of the first parts of applications, except in the case provided for in Article 48(19) of this Federal Law, it shall be conducted in the procedure established by this Federal Law subject to the following specific rules:
units.label: Part 3 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. Declaring an open competitive method unsuccessful. Consequences of such a declaration
units.text: 1) no later than one hour after receiving the record of examination and evaluation of the first parts, the electronic platform operator shall send the contracting authority the second and third parts of the application found to meet the procurement notice requirements, and the information and documents specified in Article 43(6)(2) and (3) of this Federal Law concerning the participant that submitted it;
units.label: Point 1 Part 3 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. Declaring an open competitive method unsuccessful. Consequences of such a declaration
units.text: 2) no later than two working days from the day following receipt of the information and documents under point 1 of this paragraph, but no later than the date for determining supplier (contractor, service provider) selection results set in the procurement notice:
units.label: Point 2 Part 3 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. Declaring an open competitive method unsuccessful. Consequences of such a declaration
units.text: а) the procurement commission members shall examine the information and documents sent by the electronic platform operator under point 1 of this paragraph, decide whether the application meets the procurement notice requirements or must be rejected on grounds specified in Article 48(12) of this Federal Law, and sign with enhanced electronic signatures the record of supplier (contractor, service provider) selection results prepared by the contracting authority using the electronic platform;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 2 Part 3 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. Declaring an open competitive method unsuccessful. Consequences of such a declaration
units.text: б) the contracting authority shall use the electronic platform to prepare the record of supplier (contractor, service provider) selection results and, after the procurement commission members sign it under subpoint “а” of this point, sign it with the enhanced electronic signature of a person authorized to act on its behalf and send it to the electronic platform operator. No later than one hour after receiving it, the operator shall post it in the unified information system and on the electronic platform;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 2 Part 3 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. Declaring an open competitive method unsuccessful. Consequences of such a declaration
units.text: 3) neither the procedure for submitting offers of the contract price or of the total of unit prices of goods, works or services (in the case provided for in Article 22(24) of this Federal Law), nor evaluation against the application evaluation criteria set in the procurement notice, shall be carried out;
units.label: Point 3 Part 3 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. Declaring an open competitive method unsuccessful. Consequences of such a declaration
units.text: 4) the record of supplier (contractor, service provider) selection results must contain the information specified in Article 48(17)(1), (2) and (4)–(7) of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 4 Part 3 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. Declaring an open competitive method unsuccessful. Consequences of such a declaration
units.text: 5) after the record of supplier (contractor, service provider) selection results is posted in the unified information system, the participant may send the request provided for in Article 48(18) of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 5 Part 3 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. Declaring an open competitive method unsuccessful. Consequences of such a declaration
units.text: 6) if a decision under point 2(а) of this paragraph finds the application compliant with the procurement notice requirements, the contract with the participant that submitted it shall be concluded under Article 93(1)(25) of this Federal Law in the procedure established by this Federal Law.
units.label: Point 6 Part 3 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. Declaring an open competitive method unsuccessful. Consequences of such a declaration
units.text: 4. If, in the case provided for in paragraph 1(2) of this Article, an electronic tender is declared unsuccessful following examination of the second parts of applications, it shall be conducted in the procedure established by this Federal Law subject to the following specific rules:
units.label: Part 4 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. Declaring an open competitive method unsuccessful. Consequences of such a declaration
units.text: 1) the evaluations specified in Article 48(11)(1)(б) and (15)(1)(а) of this Federal Law shall not be carried out;
units.label: Point 1 Part 4 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. Declaring an open competitive method unsuccessful. Consequences of such a declaration
units.text: 2) the contract with the participant that submitted an application meeting the procurement notice requirements shall be concluded under Article 93(1)(25) of this Federal Law in the procedure established by this Federal Law.
units.label: Point 2 Part 4 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. Declaring an open competitive method unsuccessful. Consequences of such a declaration
units.text: 5. If, in the case provided for in paragraph 1(2) of this Article, an electronic auction is declared unsuccessful following examination of applications, the contract with the participant that submitted an application meeting the procurement notice requirements shall be concluded under Article 93(1)(25) of this Federal Law in the procedure established by this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. Declaring an open competitive method unsuccessful. Consequences of such a declaration
units.text: 6. If an electronic request for quotations is declared unsuccessful in the cases provided for in paragraph 1(1) and (2) of this Article, the contract with the participant that submitted an application meeting the procurement notice requirements shall be concluded under Article 93(1)(25) of this Federal Law in the procedure established by this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. Declaring an open competitive method unsuccessful. Consequences of such a declaration
units.text: 7. In the case provided for in paragraph 1(3) of this Article, the contracting authority shall use the electronic platform to prepare the record of supplier (contractor, service provider) selection results, containing the information specified in Article 48(17)(1), except application identification numbers, and (7) of this Federal Law. It shall sign the record with the enhanced electronic signature of a person authorized to act on its behalf and send it to the electronic platform operator, which shall post it in the unified information system and on the electronic platform no later than one hour after receiving it.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. Declaring an open competitive method unsuccessful. Consequences of such a declaration
units.text: 8. In the cases provided for in paragraph 1(3)–(6) of this Article, the contracting authority may conduct a new procurement under this Federal Law or procure from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider) under Article 93(1)(25) of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 52
